search.checker: external finite observational-equivalence search; frozen compiler unchanged

model.metadata: All byte symbols have the same length and filename. Bodies are constant.
model.source_condition: Grant present and single-recipient mail accepted; envelope status is common infrastructure.
model.observations: Fresh opaque tags support within-attempt equality in their own domain. Item tags are unordered multisets. Raw symbols are visible when selected.

pruning_cost_order: recoverable content role-fields (body or attachment bytes)
search.pruning_sensitivity_control: expert_with_body_names adds body.raw and attachment_names.raw at each source to expert_minimal; constructed after the pilot as a sensitivity control.
search.scope: Minimal only for these fields, roles, worlds, protocol assumptions and cost. The search does not generate projection operators or measure wire bytes.

witness_replay.equality_model: Unmasked fields exact; one-sided opaque atoms alpha-renamed, paired opaque domains preserve equality, item tokens preserve joint multiplicity.
